info.title: Electoral systems simulation API
info.description: Local teaching server executing the same Python counting algorithms shown in the chapters. Start it with `python3 python/server.py`. GitHub Pages hosts documentation only. Single-winner results include intermediate counts; a final tie remains a set of co-winners. See the API guides for exact variants, tie priorities, and computational limits. Committee methods use /multi/systems and /multi/simulate with an explicit seats field. Their winners form one selected committee, and their tie flag records selection ties. The original single-winner endpoints retain their existing response meaning.

tags.name: Committees
tags.description: Discover and execute multi-winner rules. See the committee API guide for variants, exact-search limits, and tie semantics.

post.summary: Count ballots using a named method
post.description: Ballot counts repeat identical voters; they are not score multipliers selected by voters. Candidate array order is the fixed priority for internal ties. Complete rankings are required for ranked methods. Two-round uses a fixed-preference simulation, not a second voter survey. Seeded lotteries return both a sampled winner and its distribution.

200.description: Executed count, final co-winners or sampled winner, and method-specific trace.

400.description: Invalid JSON, method, ballot, option, or profile.

413.description: Request body or computation exceeds a published teaching limit.

post.summary: Elect a committee using the named rule
post.description: Runs the Python multi-winner engine. Candidate order supplies deterministic priority for selection ties; final winners are returned in input order. Random draws advance the seeded generator once per seat. Count is the multiplicity of identical voters. Integer Droop STV and CPO-STV, exact-quota QBS/EAR, sequential Phragmen, and both Simpson extensions are specified in their chapters.

tie.description: True when the final result contains multiple co-winners.

Election.description: Use the ballot format accepted by the chosen method. Rankings must list every candidate exactly once. Score and credit maps must include every candidate. Additional numeric and computation limits are documented in the API guide and enforced by the server.

limit.description: Limited-vote marks: default max(1, seats−1). Must be below seats, except the one-seat limit is one.

votes.description: Explicit nonnegative allocation to every candidate; sum must not exceed budget.

seats.description: Number of distinct candidates to elect; cannot exceed candidate count.

MultiElection.description: Committee count with a required seat count. Ballot formats, sum budgets, dynamic limits, and exact-search caps are checked by the server. Rankings must be complete and strict. The single-winner request model is separate.

winners.description: Exactly seats selected members, listed in original candidate order.

tie.description: True when selection used a tie resolution. Multiple elected members do not themselves mean a tied result.

trace.description: Method-specific tally, transfer, load, coalition, committee-comparison, or seeded draw information.
